<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="greater-demon-berserkers-and-ash-lords" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Greater demon berserkers and ash lords</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Greater demon variants found southwest of Elite Dungeon 2 and within the Zamorakian undercity elite dungeon are significantly stronger than standard greater demons.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The two wilderness variants of enhanced greater demons attack using melee (berserker) and magic (ash lord). The wilderness population is weaker than those found in the Zamorakian undercity and are poisonable </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Along with access to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buffs, this makes them ideal for slayer training.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Since they don't have any unique drops, a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1" alt="sacrificescrim" title="sacrificescrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used for additional slayer XP. This makes greater demon berserkers and ash lords some of the best AFK slayer exp in the game.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This also means there's no reason to do them off-task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 1</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 7150</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~185 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (All AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~1.3m </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (All AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Scrimshaw_of_sacrifice <strong><nowiki>Scrimshaw of sacrifice</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1" alt="sacrificescrim" title="sacrificescrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Increases slayer XP gained by 1.5X and removes all drops obtained.
    • Losses are negligible as demons do not have any uniques or otherwise valuable drops.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_incense_sticks <strong><nowiki>Kwuarm incense sticks</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1" alt="kwuarmsticks" title="kwuarmsticks" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • A large portion of your damage comes from poison.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Jas_demonbane_arrow <strong><nowiki>Jas demonbane arrows</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697055334491.png?v=1" alt="jasdemonbanearrow" title="jasdemonbanearrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Best in slot demon slaying ammo if using ranged.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_slayer_equipment <strong><nowiki>Demon slayer equipment</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325697503907910.png?v=1" alt="demonslayercirclet" title="demonslayercirclet" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Best in slot demon slaying armour if using ranged.
    • Bring 3 pieces and 1 piece of augmented power armour with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1" alt="demonslayerperk" title="demonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Passive unlocks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Guardhouse <strong><nowiki>Tier 3 guardhouse</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki>
    • Due to the high amount of HP of the demons, the chance for ultimates to instakill </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is highly beneficial for this task.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop <strong><nowiki>Restocking Cannon Ability</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki>
    • Allows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> restocking without user input, essential for AFKing.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Use the dragonkin laboratory teleport or a portal attuned to the Elite dungeon via War's Retreat. Exit via the southwest to enter the wilderness.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-strategy"><ins><nowiki>General strategy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Enhanced greater demon variants possess high damage and cannot be recklessly AoE'd unlike many other slayer mobs. Hence, it would be best to safespot them or at most tank 2 of them at once.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players who do not possess end game equipment may utilise a safespot west of the dungeon as shown below:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/QNQKfw6CFG.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ More information on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> placement and demonstration may be found </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/mSMcfhR4OKM?t=270 <nowiki>here</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players who are well-geared and can afford to tank their attacks may run south and position themselves on a small peninsula as shown below, using a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to aggro the demons.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This spot allows you to lure 5 demons in total (3 ash lords + 2 berserkers), and limits the number of demons attacking you to at most 2 at once (1 Ash lord + 1 Berserker) as other demons will be stuck behind.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/nC2nSMEQNe.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-magicranged"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK Magic/Ranged</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>With high end gear, both </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to AFK the demons, at around the same rates.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When you need to repair the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, quickly </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> out, click, and then </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> back to the suggested spot.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Check that the demons did not walk in a way which gets them stuck.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismaspect" title="vampyrismaspect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>**</nowiki><em><nowiki>Note: ** During the initial lure, the demons may get stuck in a conformation that makes them unable to approach you, to resolve this, kill the initial wave and then walk back to the suggested spot.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/UiLHx0Iiew.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
